info.long_name: Proportion of students exempt from DTaP vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption from the DTaP vaccination requirement.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding an exemption of any kind from the DTaP series. This is an exemption rate, not a coverage rate: a student without an exemption is not necessarily vaccinated, and an exempt student may still have received the vaccine, so it cannot be subtracted from one to obtain coverage.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were exempt from DTaP vaccination.

id_school_immunization.name: Idaho School Immunization Report
id_school_immunization.organization: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare
id_school_immunization.description: County-level per-series EXEMPTION rates from the Idaho DHW school immunization report (supplied to PopHIVE as "Yale School Exemption Data Request"), aggregated over kindergarten, 1st, 7th and 12th grade. EXEMPTIONS ONLY -- this source publishes no coverage, so the coverage columns are empty and only rate_<series>_exempt is populated. Do not compute coverage as 1 minus these values: a student without an exemption is not necessarily vaccinated, and an exempt student may still have received the vaccine. DHW notes that schools self-report aggregate counts and that arithmetic errors sometimes persist.
id_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
